text.p: UStel Inc said on Wednesday it completed its previously announced acquisition of Consortium 2000 Inc.
UStel issued 1,076,923 shares of its common stock in exchange for all of the shares of Consortium 2000. Consortium 2000 will function as an independent subsidiary of UStel.
Since January 1995, Consortium 2000 has had a marketing arrangement with UStel which has resulted in the major portion of the company's growth during that period.

Consortium 2000 is a telecommunications consulting and marketing firm with approximately 1,000 affiliated independent agents nationwide. UStel provides long-distance telecommunications services for commercial, residential and specialty markets to customers worldwide.
